Mod.Name: [Cronos Team] Vanilla hard mode
Mod.Author: Cronos Team
Mod.Description:
► The vanilla experience, but much harder ◄
A much harder version of the vanilla game, WITHOUT the rest of Cronos (no AI, field, shop or other changes from Cronos).
◆ Changes ◆ • Monster stats refitted to a level curve, draw lists capped to the story progression, new EXP/AP. • Fixed encounter levels per story zone. • Its own kernel.bin (character growth, junction, weapons, GFs, enemy attacks) and starting data. • Custom damage formula, damage no longer capped at 9999. • Junction strength based on the minimum between character level and stock. • Draws no longer capped at 9, limit break farming removed. • Refines keep their GF level requirement.
◆ Requirements ◆ • Incompatible with Cronos Demo: enable only one of these mods. • Requires [Cronos Team] GameplayCustomizer and [Cronos Team] Archeology. Required settings are selected automatically. • Save anywhere, Keep junctions in dreams and the censorship fixes stay your choice.
◆ Credits ◆ • Malekith: stat rework, damage and base monster stat formulas. • Hobbitdur: reverse engineering, HEXT and modding tools.

LatestVersion.ReleaseNotes: • 0.1 Split from Cronos, where it was the VanillaNightmare monsters difficulty. • 0.2 Enable Individual EXP, GF level cap and No pause during Zell's Duel through GameplayCustomizer 0.9. Cronos Demo and Vanilla hard mode remain mutually exclusive.
